newsitem.title: USA: Sirrom Capital files for 2.9 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Sirrom Capital files for 2.9 mln shr offer.

text.p: Sirrom Capital Corp said on Thursday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a 2.9 million share offering of its common stock.
The company said it planned to sell 2,680,513 shares and underwriters had a 30-day option to purchase up to 435,000 additional shares to cover any over-allotments.
Sirrom said it would use net proceeds to provide funding for the origination of loans to small businesses.
The remaining 219,487 shares will be sold by certain shareholders, Sirrom said.
